import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static final int MAXN = 10000010;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int n, m, c, d, k, totalCost = 0;
    static int s = 0, t, edgeCounter = 1;
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN], to = new int[MAXN], nxt = new int[MAXN], val = new int[MAXN], w = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN], incf = new int[MAXN], pre = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean[] inq = new boolean[MAXN];

    static void addEdge(int x, int y, int z, int v) {
        to[++edgeCounter] = y;
        nxt[edgeCounter] = head[x];
        head[x] = edgeCounter;
        val[edgeCounter] = z;
        w[edgeCounter] = v;

        to[++edgeCounter] = x;
        nxt[edgeCounter] = head[y];
        head[y] = edgeCounter;
        val[edgeCounter] = 0;
        w[edgeCounter] = -v;
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(incf, 0);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inq, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        incf[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        inq[s] = true;
        dist[s] = 0;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inq[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (val[i] == 0 || dist[to[i]] <= dist[u] + w[i]) continue;
                dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + w[i];
                incf[to[i]] = Math.min(incf[u], val[i]);
                pre[to[i]] = i;
                if (!inq[to[i]]) {
                    inq[to[i]] = true;
                    q.offer(to[i]);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != INF;
    }

    static void update() {
        int tmp = t;
        while (tmp != s) {
            int i = pre[tmp];
            val[i] -= incf[t];
            val[i ^ 1] += incf[t];
            tmp = to[i ^ 1];
        }
        totalCost += incf[t] * dist[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();

        t = (n + k - 1) * n + 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(s, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n + k; j++) {
                for (int h = 1; h <= k; h++) {
                    int cost = d * h * 2 - d + c;
                    addEdge(x + (j - 1) * n, y + j * n, 1, cost);
                    addEdge(y + (j - 1) * n, x + j * n, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < n + k; i++) {
            for (int j = 2; j <= n; j++) {
                addEdge(j + (i - 1) * n, j + i * n, INF, c);
            }
            addEdge(1 + (i - 1) * n, 1 + i * n, INF, 0);
        }

        while (spfa()) {
            update();
        }

        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
